notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you for everyone who has downloaded Valley of No Roads!

As the launch happened early in the summer, I went through burnout and couldnt really look at Steam without breaking into cold sweat. It's been the first game we have launched and now started to address all the major issues it had during the launch:

- Tutorial is now more clear and works as intended
- Tooltips are more clear and available in any game mode
- Control layouts are now available in any game mode
- Docks were not functional, but are now a essential part of gameplay

Please continue to share any issues if you come by, I will be now addressing all the bugs as they are found.

Thank you!

notes.title: Minor update to 0.931
notes.notes:
We got a minor update with the latest build, this makes it easier for new players to get started:

- [b]Default settings[/b] now start with 6x6 map, since 4x4 is definitely beyond new players. This will also result to all players settings to reset.

- [b]Market square[/b] spawn has been increased by 10%

- [b]Camera movement[/b] with mouse made more responsive.

- Bridge bugs fixed, in some cases bridges could be built from bridges.

It's great to see leaderboards filling up and things getting closer to launch!
Thank you for all the people involved!
